title.rendered: Board of Directors Special Meeting – May 22, 2024

content.rendered: The Sherwood School District Board of Directors will meet in a Special Meeting on Wednesday, May 22nd at 7pm at the District Office Board Room (21920 SW Sherwood Blvd). This is a public meeting. The purpose of this meeting will be the announcement of the new superintendent hire. Please see link below for meeting agenda.
